lines: The Operator currently has four different voices available to choose from: Owl and Heron as masculine voices, and Raven and Falcon as feminine voices. While all four speak mostly the same lines, there are different inflections for each, and wording may sometimes be minorly different.

In Update 35.5 (2024-03-27), the Operator's original voice lines were updated to replace them with the Drifter's voice actors, ensuring both versions were voiced by the same people. For the lines as they were prior to their replacement, please refer to Operator/Quotes/Original. (In-mission barks were not replaced, and can still be found on this page.)
(Note: Voices are listed here in the same order as the majority of voice files on the wiki for ease of identification.)
- Heron (A): "Whatever the answer is, it's not what we're expecting."
- Owl (B): "A normal kid with a normal life. I barely remember any of it."
- Raven (C): "Too old to cry and too young to die."
- Falcon (D): "When I think of the things I used to be afraid of, I almost feel sorry for them."
- "A jumble of words, numbers... I must have known everything about Tau. Our teacher loved when I corrected her."
(Option: ...a hand, held in mine aboard the Zariman.)
- "The soft lines of a hand, my mother's, I think. We were watching the stars, awaiting the jump to Tau. She was afraid."
- "I remember everyone was laughing outside an airlock. This kid had a boy by the throat. I didn't think it was funny at all."
- "I didn't want to live anymore. I felt guilty that I was alive, but we could do things, extraordinary things. Maybe there was a reason we survived?"
- "We were just kids, but... they were afraid of what we could do. When they tried to treat us like rats I stood up to them. I wasn't going to let them divide us after what we'd been through."
- "We were dangerous, broken. Every time they tried to fix us, someone always got hurt. I wish I could have saved them. I wish I could have taken their fear away."

- "She put us into the dream, brought us peace. I remember we could still hear her voice, raging at the leaders for their mistreatment of us. When they executed her... well... I could not let that go."
- "We couldn't help it, the outbursts. We hurt her, blinded her, but even then, she never abandoned us. In the dream we found peace, and she sang to us in that cold, dark..."
- "In dreams we could control it, focus it. So she made the pods, her favorite flower... she said sometimes... something beautiful can grow out of something ugly."
- "She confronted them even when she knew what it would cost her. Blinded and sick by her work with us... yet in her heart, stronger than all of us."
- "Maybe we felt it? Maybe it didn't matter. We had a life! We embraced it. I wanted to punish those who abused their power and now I had a way."
- "We must have known. I remembered what it was like to be afraid, to be weak. I vowed never to forget that, never to abuse what I had been given. I had a code."
- "We sensed that otherness, but we embraced it. I was free as anything! Free to learn, to experience, to mean something."
- "It was a shadow underneath what we did. That sensation of being a victim, of being helpless. I took up the sword to protect those in need."
- "There was a sense of it, but we set fear aside. I remembered what fear did. How it turned them against us. I vowed never to be controlled by it. I was going to live, or die, with honor."
- "I see a cloud, a gathering storm... the Madurai Way. Our path was to Engage The Enemy... to sweep across our foes before they had a chance to steel themselves."
- "I see a tree, of many branches, the Naramon Way. Our discipline focused on Knowing The Enemy. We believed that to truly understand a foe would confer the greatest advantage upon a warrior."
- "I see a mountain, breaking the sky. The Way of Unairu. We pushed ourselves to Outlast The Enemy, to withstand all aggression without bending."
- "I see a cresting wave, wide in the ocean, the Vazarin Way. We were trained to Counter The Enemy, and move with an opponent's attacks in order to nullify them."
- "I see a crystal, refracting the moonlight, the Way of Zenurik. We believed the path to victory was to Dominate the Enemy. That strength of spirit could overcome any resistance."
- (Owl/Falcon): "I need to think it through again."
- (Heron/Raven): "I need to think through it again."

path: Investigate the Reservoir on Lua (Zeipel, Lua)
lines: - "But we weren't born here, were we?"
- "I just saw the intruder... moving fast. I think it's Teshin."
- "Don't call me that. What are you doing here?"

path: Investigate the Reservoir on Lua (Zeipel, Lua)
lines: - "Queens?! The Grineer Queens? Tell me what--"
- "I have a feeling Teshin has. Can you track him?"
- "No. Teshin's not going to tell me what I can and cannot do. I'll take out his Specters so you can track him."
- "Why hasn't he reached out to us? If he is pursuing the Queens, we can help him."

path: Pursue Teshin into the Asteroid Field (Naga, Sedna)
lines: - "Are those Fomorian engines mounted on an asteroid? No wonder we've never been able to find it. It's always moving."
- "Negative. I'm heading in for a closer look."
**Boarding the Kuva Fortress will restrict mission access. Commit?**
- "If the base moves again, we'll lose this opportunity. I'm going in."
- "Fine. I'll head back to the Orbiter, but the base won't be here for long."

path: Infiltrate the Grineer Asteroid Fortress (Dakata, Kuva Fortress)
lines: - "Massively fortified. The Queens have to be here. I'm going to infiltrate the base."
- "Lotus? If you can hear me, something's tampering with the Transference stream. I'm going to locate the source."

path: Infiltrate the Grineer Asteroid Fortress (Dakata, Kuva Fortress)

lines: - "Just... just turn it off! Get the Transference power back on, okay? I lost my Warframe."
- "Purge? Purge what?! Ordis?! What the hell?!"
- "You... you betrayed me, you Infested piece of--"
- "So the great Teshin is just a dog... fetching the Queen's stick wherever she throws it."
- "(struggles to remove bone that stabbed into their leg)"
- "Why does it have to be ravenous?"
- "Incredible. And I was kicking myself for not bringing a rope."
- "Shadows I create. Another Teshin metaphor, right?"
- "I held out hope we'd be rescued. So I avoided the bloodshed."
- "They had lost their minds. I didn't blame them. We built a makeshift prison."
- "They were nothing but animals by then. So I hunted."
- "I... I'm fine. Just... just don't play any music. I need to think."
- "No. But I've lost my Warframe... and Teshin... what if the Queens know that he helped me escape? I have to go back."
- "No. Let her rot. That will be her sentence."
- "We have neutralized the Queens. Teshin... Teshin helped me. I'm heading to extraction now."
- "But isn't it better I know the truth? Wouldn't you want to know? Teshin said--"
- "That's what you have to say? That I'm 'changed'?"
- "Don't. Don't do that. Don't make excuses for me."
Unfiltered versions of the Man in the Wall's lines.
- "Hey, kiddo, what took you so long?"
- "Don't forget, kiddo... you're nothing without me."
- "You mad at me, kiddo? Did you forget? You owe me."
- "Scan for Sentient energy on Earth. Recent activity."
- "I don't know, but I think she wants me to see this. I'll scan the scene, check for Warframe traces."

path: After scanning the third Warframe trace

lines: - "What about Lua? You said there were traces on the weapon..."
- "What I saw... What the Lotus showed me... this Warframe knew Ballas. It tried to attack him."
- "The order may be important for the cipher."
- "Ordis! What are these? Some new Sentient design?"
- "Umbra. Cave-ins must have compromised the enclosure."
- "What? No. We need to get inside... but it's locked to a new set of codes. (sighs) I'm bringing it back for analysis."
- "This may have belonged to Ballas. He's our only way to the Lotus. Please, Ordis."
- "When I linked to it... there was something there. A... a memory."
- "Well this one does. Might be why it's unstable... Ordis - let me look at the Vitruvian."
- "Ordis. We need to track that Umbra Warframe."
- "No. The codes are in his memory. If I can get close, I'll go in again and try to recover them. He's the key to finding the Lotus, I can feel it."
- "I feel like... he's leading me to the truth, about Ballas... Right now, it's all I have to go on."
- "Ballas. He's going to kill my... his... son, Isaah."
- "--I know what I have to do."
- "I don't need to hear it. I lived it... Prep the landing craft, Ordis. I'm going in... myself."
- "My Warframe is here. I just have to find it."
- "You have relived this moment countless times. But our minds are linked now. We'll face this together."
- "This poison he's given you, it has taken your will away. You are a victim as much as your son."
- "We use this memory. It fuels our wrath."
- "We accept this memory and move beyond its reach."
- "We return this memory to the Void and find peace in our emptiness."
- "Mark a path to extraction. We've got one last mission before this is done."
- "What have you done with her? Ballas, where is the Lotus!"
(Option: Squirm like the maggot you are.)
- "Where is she? Where is the Lotus?"
- "What? What have they done to you?"
- "No. I - I don't know. But I'm going to find out."

path: The Man in The Wall encounter

lines: - "But... I don't care what you are! Why are you with them?! How could you leave me--"
- "We're through the perimeter. You're sure about this? It should be me."
- "Teshin... I'll be awaiting... so I can bring her home."
- (Raven/Falcon) "Cephalon, kill the lights, and switch off."
[Sun] Something went wrong with the jump...
- "Something went wrong with the jump. But we'll survive. Promise."
- (Heron) "Just, just try to keep quiet... and don't let him fall asleep, okay?"
- (Owl) "Just try to keep quiet... and don't let him fall asleep, okay?"
- (Raven) "Hey, just, just try to keep quiet... and don't let him fall asleep, okay?"
- (Falcon) "Just try to keep quiet... and don't let him fall asleep, okay?"
- Operator: "I don't know, but we're going to figure it out together, okay?"
- "Hey. Why don't you go sit closer to the others until we get environmental back?"
- (Heron) "Oh please, would you snap out of it? We're on our own now."
- (Owl, Raven, and Falcon) "Snap out of it. We're on our own now."
[Neutral] We'll be your family for awhile...
- Operator A: "No. She's not. We're going to be your family for a while, okay?"
- Operator A: "I know. But go on. Just for now."
- "Hey, lose your light? Here, you can take mine."
- "Around? Okay, so what is this, then? Are you from the--"
- "So... you've been stuck here this whole time?"
- "You saved her. Nursed her back to health. It has to be you."
- "Huh, it's good to be back, Ordis."
- "Cetus. She's going to Cetus. She wants that Murex!"
- "--She isn't. Not even close. We have to stop her, Ordis."
- "And that she sees time all at once. I think it's just a metaphor."
- "You're not ready! He has manipulated you for so long. He'll just own you like he owns every other Narmer."
- "Please. You're not thinking straight. You need more time to heal..."
- "What do you mean? Feed on what?"
- "We've got to stop it! What if... what if we approach the wrecked ships as cover?"
- "I know! Maybe if she was stronger we wouldn't have to!"
- "My mech's damaged! Can we take down the Orphix field?"
- "Remember! Remember what he did to you!"
- "We've got work to do. Narmer's shattered, but they've got a martyr now. And the old guard are already eager to fill the vacuum. If you're ready."
- "I know. But maybe you could choose one voice... to lead the others? It's your choice."
- "There's nothing left on that wreck but bad memories. But if I can keep it from hurting anyone else... I'll go."
- "And when I find it? Then what?"
- "The Worm Queen wants the Zariman for herself. I lost my family here. I'd sooner destroy it than see it in Grineer hands."
- "Unnh... that surge came from the Reliquary Drive! What are they doing down there?"
- "You can't be. The crew all died!"
- "Wait. Are you saying that thing I just saw..."
- "They look... older. Bigger. Like ancestors, maybe? But how?"
- "We can talk about it some time when I'm not fighting for my life, okay?"
- "I remember the singing. Picking fruit under those warm lights. Hands stained purple with Lofler Berry juice. You really think things could have been different?"
- "I'm not afraid of responsibility. But this is where everything that could go wrong, went wrong. Once we're done here, I'm done here."
- "Yeah, we covered Conceptual Embodiment in T.A."
- ""Though all betwixt is dark and deep, a home awaits us there." Yeah. We really thought we'd make it."
- "You can hold out. I know you can."
- "I'll stop the Grineer. And Kira too."
- "I'll do right by the Zariman, just like you did. I promise."
- "Just... ghosts. I think we all lost today."
- "You say that. But this place... I can't forget what it's put me through. Everyone through."
- "This isn't just a bad memory, is it? This is new."
- "I've seen that device before. Some kind of... communicator?"
- "It's him. I knew he'd come after you next!"
- "It's okay, Loid. have to... I want to."
- "I had a friend, Loid. Like me. His name was... was... Adis."
- "Can you believe we used to be at war?"
- "It's just... insane. When all the time it could have been like this."
- "Oh, they'd invite you to dinner, then panic over what to feed you."
- "Did they ever tell you what happened to your ancestors?"
- "I've been working on some new moves. Gonna let me try them out on you?"
- "Anything you want to go over before Itzam grills you?"
- "Again? Okay, don't sweat it. I've got your back."
- "Go charge up, Adis. I've got your back."
- "You're the only ones keeping this war alive."
- "I'm sorry! I didn't want to! It was him or me... him or me!"
(Option: She's trying to restart the war by turning Sentients hostile.)
- "War. Using the Sentients as her tools."
(Option: She wants Tau for herself and her followers.)
- "Tau. All of it. Just for her and her people."
- "There are still too many unknown factors."
- "Never. So, uh... do you wanna go hunting? With me?"
- "Adis, get on comms. We need intel. I'm going after them."
- "Orokin houses clash all the time. Dax can kill troops, they just can't hurt the Golden Lords themselves."
- "But what happens if you don't get them?"
- "Gonna scramble this targeting array, Adis. That ought to bring a Lustratus out of hiding."
- "Galastra shot down a shuttle. She's got to be after the passengers."
- "This was a VIP transport. Whoever Galastra's hunting, they're Orokin."
- "Tauron student, first class division M four dash A. By the glory and wisdom of the Seven I salute you."
- "Keep monitoring, Adis. We need to know more."
- "Adis... did... did your people do this?"
- "Seal the doors, Loid. I have to go deeper."
- "Valdur? Come in, damn it! You've got a rogue battalion down here!"
- "It's... me. I can't do this. I don't want to do this!"
- "Loid. What. No. You can't be here on Tau."
- "But we're almost at the part where..."
- "Prep the machine, Loid. I have to go back."
- "Ballas and the others. They used us. Set us up."
- "Adis, you've got to stop! This is what they wanted!"
- "Margulis couldn't have done this! Think, Adis! This is a setup!"
- "They're coming to kill us both! Don't you see? They'll cover it up! They always do!"
- "Shh. It's okay. It's okay. We're together."
- "I should've let Galastra tear you apart!"
- "A change of heart? From a bigot like you? I don't buy it."
- "Rap, tap, tap! You'll let me in, little piggy!"
- "Tell me you had nothing to do with it!"
- "But Ballas... if he did this... he'll kill y-you..."
- "Yes. I mean... I don't want it to change."

Note: These voice lines were not updated alongside the Operator's other lines in Update 35.5 (2024-03-27). They play only when the Operator is selected in the Base of Operations; there are no Drifter-equivalent lines. Many of the lines do not play in-game any longer, but are kept here for archival purposes.
- "We know the mission, we will not fail."
- "Transference signal strong, we're ready for battle."
- "We will bring honor to the Tenno."
- "My Warframe is the hand and I am the will."
- "The Grineer deteriorate over time... is that what makes them violent?"
- "Grineer prey on the weak but we... we prey on the Grineer."
- "The Grineer used to be builders but now all they make is war."
- "Ballistics and archaic weapons, crude and dangerous, just like the Grineer."
- "You'd think they'd clone something a little less... ugly."
- "If we can avoid alerting them, this might be easier."
- "These Corpus remind me of the Orokin, selfish, greedy."
- "Corpus technology won't be enough to stop us."

- "They'll have plenty of Robotics. Corpus never fight for themselves."
- "Okay, ready to blast these machines into spare parts?"
- "Corpus have tech weapons, we'll need to be careful."
- "So... the Corpus are just a cult, worshiping money."
- "I remember these monsters from long ago."
- "What a mess. Let's clean it up!"
- "Disgusting monstrosities, I think they absorb their victims."
- "We need to purge this place, as we did in the old days."
- "Ancients are the most powerful, age and feeding has made them strong."
- "Some explode when killed, we'll need to strike and move."
- "We're immune to this Infestation, but they still try to kill us."
- "Move and strike, we have to win this!"
- "I will consider what I've learned from this skirmish."
- "I think there are more up ahead."
- "Need to keep a look out for supplies..."
- "We'll need to watch for aquatic targets."
- "Internals damaged, we need to watch it."
- "Keeping talking... we're still trying to figure out how dumb you are."

- "Say what you want, we're still coming for you."
- "You are the mission, I will not falter."
